prompt: The editor wants one new full photo for the public gallery, not another close-up. Which plan is feasible under the current permissions and schedule?
promptZh: 編輯想替公開圖庫新增一張全幅照，而不是再加一張特寫。依目前的授權和時間安排，哪項做法可行？

options.zh: 十點五十分：用紙片遮擋後拍攝 17 號。
options.whyZh: 即使紙片不接觸作品、遮擋方式符合泰莎的要求，紙片也要到十一點才送到。

options.zh: 十一點：拍攝 42 號，以編號標示。
options.whyZh: 不標姓名也不能取代製作者的網路照片授權，琳未准許任何線上照片。

options.zh: 十一點十分：用紙片遮擋後拍攝 17 號。
options.whyZh: 即使遮擋方式符合泰莎的要求，攝影人員十一點零五分就離開了。

options.text: 11:00: photograph 17 with initials screened without contact; label by number.
options.zh: 十一點：用紙片擋住 17 號的姓名縮寫，不碰到作品，拍照後以編號標示。
options.whyZh: 十一點紙片已就緒、攝影人員尚未離開；紙片不碰作品並遮住姓名縮寫，即可按泰莎授權拍攝並用編號上傳。

explanationZh: 十一點紙片已就緒、攝影人員尚未離開；紙片不碰作品並遮住姓名縮寫，即可按泰莎授權拍攝並用編號上傳。
evidence: Gallery photos need online approval and must show no names or initials; caption by entry number. / Online photos approved, but a new full view requires a paper screen hiding the initials without touching the quilt. / No online photos, even anonymous ones. / The paper screen arrives at eleven. The photographer leaves at eleven five.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Gallery photos need online approval and must show no names or initials; caption by entry number.
Online photos approved, but a new full view requires a paper screen hiding the initials without touching the quilt.
No online photos, even anonymous ones.
The paper screen arrives at eleven. The photographer leaves at eleven five.

vocabulary.note: 把作品整件拍進畫面，而非只拍局部特寫。
